newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR FEB 4-DEC 31, 1997 (PAGE 1/10 - FEB 4-24).
newsitem.headline: REUTER EC REPORT LONG-TERM DIARY FOR FEB 4-DEC 31, 1997 (PAGE 1/10 - FEB 4-24).

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
AMSTERDAM - Dutch presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (June 16-17).
MADRID - NATO holds summit to set the course for enlargement (July 8 and 9).
LUXEMBOURG - Luxembourg presidency hosts European Council of heads of state or government (December 12-13).
TUESDAY, FEBRUARY 4

THE HAGUE (MODIFIED ITEM) - Please note that Russian President Boris Yeltsin has cancelled his scheduled meeting with Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok. Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov, however, will meet Dutch Foreign Minister Hans van Mierlo to discuss EU-Russian relations.
WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 5

Provisional agenda includes:
- Commissioner Cresson communication on the fifth framework programme, scientific and technological objectives.
- Commissioner Oreja communication on exclusive transmission of sports events.
- Commissioner Papoutsis white paper on associations and foundations.
